readout_other: pain intensity NRS (0-100) during cold gel stimulus; seed-based and ICA resting-state fMRI connectivity; MEGA-PRESS MRS GABA and Glx
direction_notes: No main effect on pain ratings at any single time point; a greater reduction in pain from T1 to T2 under active TUS, increased dACC connectivity with SMA, premotor cortex and anterior insula, decreased with PAG; no significant MRS change.
safety_notes: Symptom questionnaire after each session; mild symptoms (e.g. headache, tingling, sleepiness, dizziness) reported after both active and sham, one moderate sleepiness; none severe.

device.model: NeuroFUS TPO system and CTX-500-4 four-element annular transducer

timing.protocol_description: 10 Hz-patterned protocol with 10% duty cycle, pulse duration 10 ms, pulsed every 100 ms, applied for 80 s at each of three dACC targets sequentially (4 min in total), A to C order.

source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: a Participants completed three sessions; in the first session, T1-weighted and PETRA scans were acquired for neuronavigation and acoustic planning, then in sessions 2 and 3, they received either active TUS to the dACC or sham, followed by completing fMRI and MRS scans.
